entries.topic: Pending Android Picker/Reporter long-press SKU clipboard across all visible result states

Scope includes Picker and Reporter records in reporting/processing, confirmed stock available, allowed Skip, retracted and overdue statuses; any other same-record views to be enumerated during analysis.

No code, APK, API schema, deployment or runtime behavior changes approved now.

entries.topic: Pending Inventory responder full name and response time attribution on SKU results
facts: Owner asks to show who in Inventory replied/confirmed SKU with display name and response timestamp; example is an Inventory reply at 15:50, with the person name deliberately redacted in this public repository.

Distinct actors must be preserved across result status, later correction, reporter/Picker retraction and catalog SKU sync; no false attribution to Picker, SKU catalog uploader, Agent or unrelated operators.

If existing current screen data includes actor name/time, local render creates no extra Service/Firebase/API read; if absent, data source, display-name lookup/cache and marginal Usage must be verified rather than claiming zero Usage.
No public employee personal name, new database column, API request or deployment is authorized by this record-only command.
